about:
Pacific Performance Engineering (PPE) is based in North Las Vegas, Nevada. The company's founding year, ownership structure, and founders are not publicly disclosed in the available sources.

PPE offers a range of aftermarket performance parts for GM 6.6L Duramax diesel engines, including CNC-ported cast iron cylinder heads, differential covers, transmission pans, engine oil pans, cooling system components, intercooler and boost tubes, intake/turbo/exhaust components, manifolds and up-pipes, tuners, and tie rods. The company sells cylinder head kits that service two complete heads.

The products target automotive performance enthusiasts, diesel truck owners, and repair shops servicing heavy-duty GM trucks from the 2004.5–2010 model years.

No specific differentiators or founding mission statements are provided in the source material.
